text:
Public library apps like Libby and Hoopla offer incredible convenience, but they aren't always foolproof. Sync glitches, expired licenses, or de-listed titles can turn a seamless reading session into a frustrating dead end. 

This is where a manual fallback becomes essential. Instead of relying solely on the app's interface, keep your library’s direct website bookmarked. If the app fails to load a title or glitches during a download, you can bypass the middleman and manage your loans directly through the source. Don't let a software hiccup interrupt your reading.
